testsuite.name: com.uade.dda2.server.feature.auth.CookieAuthFlowTest

testcase.name: login requires csrf even without session or with Bearer()
multi role cookie cannot authenticate until role selected and pending survives reload()
logout clears all cookies including broken session and requires csrf()
cookie writes reject missing and wrong csrf and accept matching token()
each deployed API allows its frontend credentials and rejects the other environment()
missing invalid and operational selection cookies are rejected()
Bearer stays compatible and wins over cookie without falling back on invalid header()
login issues HttpOnly cookie without exposing JWT and me survives reload()
expired access and selection JWTs cannot authenticate but allow csrf and logout()
CORS permits configured credentialed origin and csrf header but rejects foreign origin()
broken previous cookie does not prevent login and bad credentials do not issue access()
